products.title: New York Basketball Wood/Hybrid Golf Headcover
products.body_html:
Handmade in my Portland, Oregon workshop, this blue, orange, and white golf headcover is made from a reclaimed vintage New York John Starks basketball jersey.

It features marine-grade stitching, and comes pretreated for UV and water protection. The middle structural layer is made from American-made industrial poly felt, making the entire headcover machine washable.

The fleece liner is made from orange Polartec 200, the original premium and highly durable fleece.

To craft this design, I repositioned the embroidered Champion patch from the chest of the jersey it's at the top. Then I took the orange-and-white ribbing from the neckline and added it to the bottom, finishing off with an orange zigzag stitch to create a touch of added visual and physical texture.

Details:

  • Fits most any modern golf wood or hybrid
  • Handmade in Portland, USA
  • Exterior crafted out of 100% upcycled materials
  • Double stitched final seam for toughness

products.title: Flame Magnetic Hat Clip
products.body_html:
No more losing your Matchstick Golf ball markers! Our Flame magnetic hat clip is here to keep your ball marks securely attached to anywhere you want to rock it. Made of extra thick metal and finished in brilliant chrome, we've also designed this clip to inset the magnet below the surface on the bottom of clip for extra friction against the bill of your hat.

The clip features an extra strong 20mm magnet to make sure your marker never slips off, meaning you'll always know your favorite design of ours is safe when you go for that birdie putt.

We've done this hat clip in the shape of the flame on our Matchstick Man logo, complete with inset lettering and paint filled for an extra touch of class.  No more boring circle markers bought next to the counter at a big box store. Step up your game and keep your markers safe!

Measurements:

  • 1.45" tall x 0.9" wide x 0.25" thick
  • 1.5 mm thick
  • Weighs a sturdy 8g
  • Magnetic

products.title: Custom Golf Headcovers

• Handcrafted from start to finish in Matchstick’s Portland, Ore. workshop

Individually handcrafted and never mass-produced, each Matchstick Golf heacover is an exploration in fibercraft through textiles, texture, and concept. Made from reclaimed materials or new, premium fabric with thoughtfully-sourced details, let's reimagine and repurpose something for the golf course, together.

Your project might begin with a meaningful garment or reclaimed textile; or new, heritage tailorables like waxed canvas, raw denim, or full-grain leather. You could incorporate an existing patch, metal hardware, or another distinctive element worth featuring as the hero element of your golf bag. It's about making something bespoke and lasting for years to come.

Simply choose your headcover size and quantity, then share the materials, colors, and details you have in mind. You can provide your own materials, or work with us to source the right textiles and components for the project. We’ll confirm the final direction with you after purchase and before production begins.

products.title: Tiger Roar Relief Print
products.body_html:
The GOAT is now a piece of fine art. Made right here in-house at Matchstick, this linoleum reduction relief print shows Tiger Woods screaming in victory at the Masters. 

Complete with golf ball dimple accents across the shirt and hat, the multi-block reduction print was brought to life by local Portland artist Audrey Delgado.

In a reduction print, each layer of colored ink is laid across a block to form pieces of the final piece. Then the linoleum block is hand-carved by the artist to create the next layer. That means the original block for this piece is now destroyed, and it can never be re-created. And because of the artist's hand registration, each piece is absolutely unique.

This is a limited edition series of 15 prints complete with artist signature and sequential numbered edition.

Details:

  • Plate: Linoleum relief print, multi-block, reduction
  • InK: Speedball block printing water-soluble ink
  • Paper: pH neutral Japanese Masa paper
  • Paper Size: 10" x 12"
  • Print Size: 7.75" x 9"
  • Total numbered editions: 15
  • Certificate of authenticity with serial number and date
  • Framed and double matted

Stop scrounging for your rangefinder all round long! Now you can keep your rangefinder handy with this Jones Rangefinder Pouch featuring our "Matchstick Man" design embroidered on the side. Clip it on your Jones bag with the YKK carabiner, and secure your laser with the cinch-close top.

And because you're rocking the Matchstick logo, everybody knows you're going to set fire to the greens once you get there. All that's left is to laser up your approach and throw a dart.

The new R-series features a recycled, ripstop material, woven from 100% PET single-use plastic bottles. 

Details

  • Water resistant
  • Recycled F35-R ripstop fabric
  • Dimensions: 8" x 7" x 1"
  • YKK carabiner
  • Cinch-close top

Discounts do not apply to this product.

This product is made to order and cannot be canceled or returned once placed. Embroidery and production time is four weeks before shipment.

products.title: Sticker Pack
products.body_html:
Matchstick's custom sticker pack. Throw 'em on your push cart, water bottle, cooler, car window, or laptop!

Each sticker in the pack is 3" on its longest side and made of super high quality vinyl. Made from weatherproof material, all feature a split back for an easy peel. Most stickers are glossy, with a couple that are matte.

There are 13 stickers in the pack and they come in our classic window ziploc pouch, which can be re-used for golf goodies at a later date.

Stickers in the pack include:

  • Lemon-Lime Putterade
  • Playing Cards
  • Fruit Punch Putterade
  • Golf Boy
  • Matchbook
  • One-Eyed Alligator
  • Cash Stack
  • Sprinter Van with Jones Bag
  • Devil Horns Golf Glove
  • Blue Frost Putterade
  • Caddysaurus
  • Wood Tiger
  • Pimento Cheese
